abstract.para: Vim (Vi IMproved) is an advanced text editor providing comprehensive text editing capabilities and extensive plugin support across SUSE Linux Enterprise environments.

topic.para: The vim package follows the agile lifecycle model, maintaining the flat version update strategy established in &sles; 15. The update policy is defined as follows:

varlistentry.term: Agile lifecycle with flat version model

listitem.para: When a new upstream release is available, the vim package is updated to the latest version across all supported &suselinux; 16 codestreams (including active minor releases and LTSS phases).
Updates transition directly to the newer version, and support for the older version is discontinued upon release of the update.
Due to Vim's active upstream codebase, deploying the latest release ensures patches remain easily applicable and issues are straightforward to resolve.
